message.content: tell me about database indexing strategies

content.text: B-trees support range queries while hash indexes are O(1) for equality.

message.content: when would you use a composite index

content.text: When queries filter on multiple columns together.
Partial indexes only index rows matching a condition.
A covering index includes all columns needed by the query.

message.content: what is index bloat and how to address it

content.text: Index bloat occurs when dead tuples accumulate; VACUUM helps.

message.content: explain the difference between clustered and non-clustered indexes

content.text: Clustered indexes determine physical row order.
Write-heavy tables suffer from too many indexes.
